[AVAILABLE TOOLS]
- board_observe: View the authorized L0 packet of one node (paginated legal set).
- board_inspect: Inspect terminal/relations facts of one node without advancing.
- board_expand: Transition one node through legal actions; returns child nodes.
- board_compare: Formal differences between two nodes of this decision.
- board_finalize: Commit the decision: validate the chosen action against the ROOT node and end the decision. Call with the ROOT node id.

To execute a tool, your response MUST contain a JSON command:
```json
{"command": "<tool_name>", "arguments": {...}}
```
When you are ready to make the move, finalize with:
```json
{"command": "board_finalize", "arguments": {"node_id": "<root_node_id>", "action_id": "<action_id>"}}
```
